title: DOW-UAP-PR024, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2023
what_is_it: A US government video case file: 18 seconds of infrared sensor footage of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, submitted for resolution and released with a written description.
interpretation_warnings: The case is classified 'Unresolved' — no explanation of what the objects were is offered.
No underlying PDF text was extractable; facts rely on war.gov metadata and the official video description only.
The 'bright' and 'dark' shapes are described only as areas of contrast on an infrared sensor, not confirmed physical objects; IR footage is prone to sensor artefacts, parallax and focus effects.
The white flash at 00:17 is attributed to a sensor setting change, not to the object itself.
Exact date, platform type and precise location within the Middle East are not disclosed.
The official note states the description is 'for informational purposes only' and appears truncated in the source.

key_facts.source_quote: aboard a U.S. military platform in 2023

verifiable_claims.claim: The footage is 18 seconds long and came from an infrared sensor on a US military platform in 2023.
verifiable_claims.source_quote: consisting of 18 seconds of video footage from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform in 2023
